sla.measurement: Micrometer timers on the provider, compared against the consumer-side timeout

fallback: The SPA surfaces the gateway's problem+json message and keeps the wizard state in its signal store so the user can re-submit; a confirmation can be safely re-submitted because it is idempotent on confirmationKey.
notes: Browser-side. No automatic retry: a mutating request must not be replayed without the user's intent.
6 concurrent requests is the practical per-origin HTTP/1.1 browser limit; HTTP/2 multiplexing makes it advisory.
verification: Fault-injection test asserting the timeout, the retry count and the circuit-breaker transitions, plus a load test showing p99 inside the timeout.
